key_grammar.source_sentence: Many studies have shown that not only do animals have a remarkable ability to seek out the best available locations for the necessities of life, but that they are able to anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs.

explanation.text: 'not only A but (also) B'는 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'라는 뜻의 상관접속사예요.
부정어구 not only가 절 앞으로 나오면 뒤의 주어와 (조)동사가 도치돼요.
not only + 조동사(do/does/did/be/have) + 주어 + 동사 ~, but (also) + 주어 + 동사.
본문에서는 'not only do animals have ~'처럼 조동사 do가 주어 animals 앞으로 나와 도치됐어요.
A와 B는 문법적으로 대등해야 해요. 본문은 'that절 ~ but that절 ~'로 균형을 맞췄습니다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: 부정어구 not only가 that절 앞으로 나오면서 조동사 do가 주어 animals 앞으로 도치되었다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: Many studies [[1|have shown]] that not only [[2|animals have]] a remarkable ability [[3|to seek out]] the best available locations for the necessities of life, but that they [[4|are able to]] anticipate [[5|how]] a setting will serve their future needs.
drills.fix: 부정어구 not only가 절 앞에 나오면 조동사 do가 주어 앞으로 도치되어야 하므로 animals have를 do animals have로 고쳐야 한다. 나머지 have shown, to seek out, are able to, how는 원문 그대로 옳다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: Later, though, [[when/during]] nests [[are built/built]] and hungry baby birds need nourishment, it is the red spruce forest [[that/what]] offers the easier pickings.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: ④ Somehow, the warbler has been guided to settle in locations what will suit its future parenting needs better than its present ones.
drills.fix: 선행사 locations를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사가 필요하므로 what을 that으로 고쳐야 한다.
options: ① The ability to select a set of surroundings suitable for foraging, shelter from predators, and the availability of mates is one of the most important determinants of biological success ― measured as survival to reproductive age and the production of offspring.

② For example, the black-throated green warbler, a small songbird that nests in spruce forests of eastern North America, establishes territories preferentially among the red spruce trees early in the summer months, even though these trees offer less food than the neighboring white spruce trees.

③ Many studies have shown that not only do animals have a remarkable ability to seek out the best available locations for the necessities of life, but that they are able to anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs.
④ Somehow, the warbler has been guided to settle in locations what will suit its future parenting needs better than its present ones.
⑤ Later, though, when nests are built and hungry baby birds need nourishment, it is the red spruce forest that offers the easier pickings.

drills.question: 그녀는 두 개의 언어를 말할 뿐만 아니라 세 개의 악기도 연주한다.
drills.answer: Not only does she speak two languages, but she also plays three instruments.

drills.answer: Many studies have shown that not only do animals have a remarkable ability to seek out the best available locations for the necessities of life, but that they are able to anticipate how a setting will serve their future needs.
